messages:
Harper: pasted a new compact flow for the rerank preview + export. trying to address two things: explainability in-row and safer exports. figma: https://figma.redwood/rerank-explain-export :eyes:
Noah: love the in-row explain badges. Quick question: are those computed client-side or from the reranker? we need consistent labels for export headers
Sofia: UX: the badges should be tappable to expand a micro-panel that shows the factors contributing to score (similarity, recency, metadata boost). that panel should have a keyboard shortcut (Enter on chip) and a clear SR label
Miguel: backend: we can surface a compact JSON blob with score_breakdown for each row. Export schema needs a version string so old CSV parsers don't silently break when we add score fields
Leah (PM): timeline: can we land the UI affordances this sprint? the explain panel + export schema versioning are important for customers doing audits
Harper: propose: - show small "i" icon next to relevance chip. on click/keyboard, open inline flyout with bullet list: Similarity: 0.86; Metadata boost: +0.12; Final score: 0.98. - add a visually hidden heading: "Score breakdown" for SRs. - include a toggle in export modal: "Include score breakdown" (off by default)
Noah: agree on toggle. Also add CSV header prefix: "schema_v=2" comment row at top or a dedicated column "_schema_version" so downstream tooling knows how to parse
Sofia: a11y nits: - ensure flyout is announced with aria-live polite + focus moves into it. - pressing Esc should close and return focus to the chip. - chips need a 2nd indicator (text) for colorblind users: e.g., "High"/"Med"/"Low" next to dot
Miguel: infra note: if users include breakdowns, export size increases. we'll compute an estimated size and show it on the export CTA: "Export (incl. breakdowns, ~4.2 MB)". Also we can compress JSON fields in the CSV (base64 gzip) for advanced users, but default should be human-readable
Leah (PM): copy suggestion: modal header -> "Export vectors and metadata". Export toggle label -> "Include score breakdown (adds extra columns)". Toast -> "Export queued: we'll email a download link when ready"
Harper: privacy check: score breakdowns may reveal model internals. Add a tooltip: "Score breakdown shows normalized signals used for ranking. Do not share if restricted" and log when users opt-in to include breakdowns
Noah: telemetry: add an event export_with_breakdown and include row_count and approx_bytes. Helps infra prioritize and billing insights
Sofia: add keyboard-only flow doc in Figma: open kebab -> Export -> tab to toggle -> confirm. Also NVDA/VoiceOver test: flyout announcement + table column order with new breakdown columns
a11y-bot: lint: flyout aria-live should be polite to avoid interrupting screen reader during table navigation. contrast check good for chips but ensure 3:1 for small UI elements
Miguel: will add schema_v column and a backend flag to include breakdowns. we'll also add a size estimate endpoint so UI can show approximate bytes without enqueuing
Leah (PM): ok consensus: implement explainability flyouts, SR-friendly chips, export toggle for breakdowns (off by default), schema_v in CSV, filesize estimate, and add telemetry for breakdown exports. Follow-up: compression and policy wording next cycle
Harper: I'll update the Figma screens and add the keyboard screencast + SR copy. tagging everyone when ready :slightly_smiling_face:
Noah: thanks all, this should cut support noise and make exports auditable
Sofia: adding a small note to the accessibility checklist about focus return and aria-live politeness
Leah (PM): great work team 44D closing thread
